description: Claude Code in auto mode, its turn closed with background agents still running, and the last line of its report tells the user how to unblock a DIFFERENT pane: 'tap Reply and type "1"'. That "1" is advice about another pane's menu, quoted inside a sentence, not a reply this pane is asking for: the card must offer no "1" button (it did, as a question with option "1"). Fictional screen (tmux-rc, 2026-10-25).
